ask: Why is it on the path?
cards: The father of history: travel, marvels and the Persian Wars, told so the deeds of men not fade.
The Peloponnesian War by a general who fought in it, history as unflinching analysis of power.
A Greek hostage in Rome who set out to explain, in forty books, how one city conquered his world in fifty-three years.
China's grand historian, who chose disgrace over silence to finish the Records that shaped two millennia of Chinese memory.
The Muqaddimah's author, who made the rise and fall of dynasties a science centuries before sociology had a name.
